title: English practice
subject: english
source: Written by the Magana team. Our own wording; not past questions. CC BY 4.0.
review: Sample: to be reviewed by a English teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: Choose the word nearest in meaning to rapid.
Neither the teacher nor the pupils blank late. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: With neither and nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, the pupils: were.

questions.question: What is the plural of phenomenon?
Which of these words is a preposition?
questions.explanation: Under is a preposition. It shows position.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to generous.
The wind whispered through the trees. What figure of speech is this?
questions.explanation: The wind is given a human action, whispering. That is personification.

questions.question: What is the past tense of go?
questions.explanation: Today I go. Yesterday I went.

questions.question: She has lived here blank 2020. Which word fits?
questions.explanation: We use since with a point in time, like 2020.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: The ball was kicked by Musa.
questions.explanation: In the passive voice the thing acted on comes first: the ball was kicked by Musa.

questions.question: He apologised blank coming late. Which word fits?
